observations: Reviewer identity: the runtime gave me no task ID, so reviewer.task is null. The parent must supply the real one. I opened these myself with Read: assets/panels/09-2.png and workflow/review/page-09.png. I read the 09-2 scene and production through a search of a page-9 request. I did not open vision-cast.png, so I compared the specialist only against the request's text description and face traits.

The pale-blue rounded vignette border and the light, airy palette are present, so the panel reads as a vision and not a current feature. A modern glass clinic sits below three small clinic silhouettes linked by dotted lines in the sky. There are no signs, logos or text.

The specialist matches the description. He has greying salt-and-pepper hair, rimless rectangular glasses, bushy brows, a long face with smile lines and a grey moustache, a light-grey blazer over a pale-blue shirt, and a stethoscope around his neck that is not in use.
Hands match production. His right hand (viewer's left) is extended with an open, welcoming palm. His left hand hangs relaxed and empty at his side.

Lettering on page-09.png: the 'WELBUK VISION' label sits top-left over the sky. The bottom caption (about page x 522-963, y 322-460) covers his lower body, his relaxed left hand and the clinic steps. His face and the open welcoming hand, which ends at about y 310, stay above it, and so do the dotted connection lines.
